# The Lab

> The Lab (https://lab.ethpandaops.io) is ethPandaOps' Ethereum network analytics site. Its pages are a client-side app, so fetching a page URL returns no data. Every number on the site comes from a public, read-only HTTP API on the same host, with no key.

The API describes itself. Use these endpoints to find what data exists, what each field means and how to query it.

## Discover

- [Networks](https://lab.ethpandaops.io/api/v1/config): JSON listing every network the API serves (`networks[].name`) with its genesis time and fork schedule. Use the name as `{network}` below.
- [OpenAPI spec](https://lab.ethpandaops.io/api/v1/mainnet/openapi.yaml): an OpenAPI 3 YAML spec per network, at `/api/v1/{network}/openapi.yaml`. It lists every endpoint with its fields, their descriptions and every filter it accepts. It is large (around 10 MB); download it once and search it rather than reading it whole.
- [Coverage](https://lab.ethpandaops.io/api/v1/mainnet/bounds): JSON at `/api/v1/{network}/bounds` giving the `min` and `max` processed position of each table. A position is a unix timestamp or a block number, depending on the table. Data outside that range has not been processed yet, which is not the same as it not having happened.

## Query

- Endpoints are `GET /api/v1/{network}/{table}` and return JSON.
- Filters are query parameters named `<field>_<operator>`, as listed per endpoint in the spec.
- Parameters marked `x-required-group: primary_key` in the spec are mandatory: send at least one of them, or the API answers `{"code":3,"message":"primary key field <field> is required"}`.
- `page_size`, `page_token` and `order_by` control paging and order; each response's `next_page_token` fetches the next page.
- Read the error messages; they say what is missing or invalid.
- Please keep requests bounded with filters and reasonable page sizes.

## More

- [panda](https://github.com/ethpandaops/panda): ethPandaOps' CLI and MCP server for querying the underlying ClickHouse, Prometheus and Loki data directly, beyond what the Lab API exposes.
- [Source](https://github.com/ethpandaops/lab): the Lab frontend. The API is served by [cbt-api](https://github.com/ethpandaops/cbt-api) over tables built by [xatu-cbt](https://github.com/ethpandaops/xatu-cbt).
